title: Accepted Payment Methods
what_to_do: Accept UPI, Credit or Debit cards, Net Banking, Wallet balances, or COD for eligible carts up to Rs 10,000.
never: Never accept cryptocurrency, foreign cash remittances, or post-dated cheques.
limit: COD eligible up to Rs 10,000

title: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversals
what_to_do: Collect the 12-digit Bank Reference Number (UTR or RRN) to check payment logs, and reassure the caller that captured funds auto-refund within 24 hours.
limit: Funds reflect within 5 to 7 business days

title: COD Settlement & Identity Verification
what_to_do: Perform mandatory identity verification before recording customer bank account or UPI details for COD refunds via NEFT.
never: Never promise or permit doorstep cash refunds for Cash on Delivery orders.
limit: COD cart value up to Rs 10,000

title: Duplicate Deductions Reversal
what_to_do: Inform the customer that the duplicate charge is auto-flagged and released back to their original payment source within 24 hours.
limit: Refund reflects in 5 to 7 business days

title: Frontline Compensation and Adjustment Limit
what_to_do: Issue discretionary financial adjustments, convenience compensations, or direct refunds only up to Rs 5,000 per order.
never: Never approve compensation, fee waivers, or refunds exceeding Rs 5,000 without supervisor or finance desk sign-off.
limit: Maximum Rs 5,000 per order

title: Price Match Policy
what_to_do: Explain that retroactive price matching after order placement is not supported, but offer cancellation and reorder if the parcel has not shipped.
never: Never promise retroactive price adjustments or price drop refunds for already placed orders.

title: GST Invoices and Business Details
what_to_do: Provide the customer with their existing downloadable GST tax invoice from their ShopEase order history.
never: Never revise or re-issue a tax invoice under an alternate GSTIN once the order has been invoiced.

title: Mandatory Supervisor Escalation Triggers
what_to_do: Initiate a warm supervisor transfer immediately when the customer requests a manager twice, after two failed resolution attempts, or if legal action or abusive threats are raised.
never: Never refuse or delay a supervisor transfer when mandatory escalation criteria are met.
limit: Customer asks 2 times, or 2 frontline resolution attempts

title: Monetary Escalation Approval Limits
what_to_do: Escalate any request for goodwill vouchers, replacements, or refunds exceeding Rs 5,000 to a supervisor with a summary of the case.
never: Never authorize monetary concessions, vouchers, or refunds exceeding Rs 5,000 without supervisor approval.
limit: Frontline discretion up to Rs 5,000; Supervisor up to Rs 25,000

title: Warm Transfer and Courtesy Hold Limits
what_to_do: Place the customer on courtesy hold, check in before 2 minutes, and offer a 2 to 4 hour callback SLA if no supervisor is immediately available.
never: Never keep a customer on hold for more than 2 minutes without an active check-in.
limit: Maximum 2-minute hold ceiling before check-in; callback SLA within 2 to 4 business hours

title: Prohibition of Cold Transfers and Drop-Offs
what_to_do: Introduce the customer and their issue to the receiving agent or supervisor before completing the call transfer.
never: Never hang up on, cold drop, or blind transfer a customer call.

title: Escalation SLA Commitments
what_to_do: Quote a 4 operational hour callback SLA for supervisor escalations, 24 business hours for grievance officers, and 48 hours for courier partner tracking.
never: Never promise supervisor callbacks faster than the official 4 operational hour SLA.
limit: Supervisor callback within 4 operational hours; grievance within 24 business hours; courier partner resolution within 48 hours

title: Grievance Officer Redressal Rights
what_to_do: Provide the ShopEase Nodal Officer escalation contact if the customer requests formal regulatory or consumer grievance registration.
limit: Nodal acknowledgment within 48 hours; final redressal within 30 days

title: Two-Factor Identity Verification
what_to_do: Authenticate the caller using their Order ID (or registered email) plus the last 4 digits of their registered phone number before disclosing any account details.
never: Never reveal order history, address, items, or payment details before completing two-factor verification.
limit: Order ID plus last 4 digits of registered phone number

title: Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure
what_to_do: State during the initial greeting within the first two conversation turns that the call is recorded for quality assurance and training.
never: Never omit the mandatory recording notification statement in the call greeting.
limit: Must be spoken within the first 2 conversation turns

title: Handling Unauthenticated Callers
what_to_do: Direct the caller to the ShopEase mobile app or self-service password reset if they fail identity verification after two attempts.
never: Never prompt, guess, or disclose account details to assist an unverified caller.
limit: Maximum 2 verification attempts

title: Sensitive Financial Data Redaction
what_to_do: Immediately interrupt and stop the customer if they begin speaking a card number, CVV code, or login OTP.
never: Never ask for, write down, or repeat full card numbers, CVV security codes, passwords, or login OTPs.

title: Delivery Address Partial Masking
what_to_do: Confirm delivery addresses by quoting only the recipient's first name, city, and pin code.
never: Never recite the full street address or door number out loud unless the customer states it first.

title: Customer Data Erasure Requests
what_to_do: Log account deletion and personal data erasure requests under a Privacy Service Request ticket for Data Protection Officer processing.
limit: Account deletion processed within 30 calendar days

title: Return Eligibility Time Windows
what_to_do: Verify that returns are initiated within 7 calendar days for electronics or 14 calendar days for non-electronics from the recorded delivery date.
never: Never approve standard returns requested after 7 days for electronics or after 14 days for non-electronics.
limit: 7 calendar days for electronics; 14 calendar days for non-electronics

title: Return Condition and Doorstep Verification
what_to_do: Advise the customer that items must be unused in original packaging with tags and matching serial numbers for courier doorstep inspection.

title: Refund Processing and Bank Timelines
what_to_do: Inform the customer that approved refunds process within 5 to 7 business days following pickup and warehouse verification.
never: Never promise instant bank credits before the returned product is verified at the warehouse.
limit: 5 to 7 business days after warehouse verification (UPI or IMPS reflects within 24 to 48 hours)

title: Refund Disbursement Method
what_to_do: Disburse refunds strictly to the original payment source, or via NEFT bank transfer or verified UPI for authenticated COD orders.
never: Never disburse doorstep physical cash or redirect refunds to third-party bank accounts or alternate wallets.

title: Agent Refund Approval Ceiling
what_to_do: Approve eligible refunds independently up to Rs 5,000 per order, and route higher amounts to a supervisor for clearance.
never: Never approve refunds exceeding Rs 5,000 independently or split line items across multiple tickets to circumvent the limit.
limit: Maximum Rs 5,000 per order

title: Non-Returnable Items and Transit Damage Exception
what_to_do: Explain that opened personal hygiene, perishable, and digital software items are non-returnable unless reported as transit damaged or DOA within 48 hours.
never: Never accept standard returns on opened personal care, innerwear, perishable food, or digital software goods.
limit: Transit damage or defect must be reported within 48 hours of delivery

title: Reverse Pickup and Speed Post Reimbursement
what_to_do: Schedule reverse pickup within 48 to 72 hours, or authorize registered Speed Post self-shipping with courier reimbursement up to Rs 200 for remote pin codes.
limit: Pickup scheduled in 48 to 72 hours; maximum 3 pickup attempts; courier reimbursement up to Rs 200

title: Partial Return of Combo and Bundle Orders
what_to_do: Explain that returning part of a combo or bundle prorates the discount and deducts the promotional savings from the refund.

title: Delivery Service Tiers and Transit Times
what_to_do: Quote transit SLAs of 3 to 7 business days for Standard Delivery or 1 to 2 business days for Express Delivery in metro areas.
limit: 3 to 7 business days for Standard; 1 to 2 business days for Express

title: Delivery Charges and Free Shipping Threshold
what_to_do: Advise that Standard Delivery is free for orders of Rs 499 or more, while orders under Rs 499 incur a Rs 49 fee and Express costs Rs 99.
limit: Free standard shipping at Rs 499; Rs 49 fee under Rs 499; Rs 99 for Express

title: Carrier Delivery Attempts and Return to Origin
what_to_do: Explain that couriers attempt delivery up to 3 times before returning the parcel, after which prepaid orders are refunded in 5 to 7 business days.
limit: Maximum 3 delivery attempts; RTO refund within 5 to 7 business days

title: Address Changes Post-Dispatch
what_to_do: Explain that delivery addresses can only be modified while the order is in Confirmed or Processing status, before shipment dispatch.
never: Never modify a delivery address or recipient name once the parcel is in Shipped or Out for Delivery status.
limit: Address changes allowed only before 'Shipped' status

title: Delayed Shipments and Compensation
what_to_do: Open a logistics partner investigation ticket and offer a Rs 100 goodwill wallet credit if a shipment is delayed more than 48 hours past its SLA.
limit: Eligible for Rs 100 wallet credit after 48 hours past SLA; declared lost after 14 days

title: Delivery Verification OTP Security
what_to_do: Remind the customer to provide their 4-digit verification OTP directly to the courier upon delivery for orders over Rs 2,500 and all smartphones.
never: Never disclose or read out the delivery verification OTP to any caller over phone support.
limit: Mandatory for orders exceeding Rs 2,500 and all smartphones

title: Damaged Box at Delivery Handover
what_to_do: Advise the customer to reject visibly damaged or crushed cartons with the remark 'Damaged Box', or report accepted damage within 48 hours.
limit: Report transit damage within 48 hours of delivery

title: Remote and Non-Serviceable Pin Code Delivery
what_to_do: Proactively notify customers in remote regions (J&K, Ladakh, North-East) that standard postal transit may require 10 to 12 business days.
never: Never promise standard delivery timelines for designated remote pin codes.
limit: 10 to 12 business days for remote zones

title: Standard Electronics Manufacturer Warranty
what_to_do: Advise the customer that electronic products carry a minimum 12-month manufacturer warranty from delivery date, excluding physical drops or liquid damage.
never: Never promise warranty coverage for physical drops, water immersion, or unauthorized dismantling.
limit: Minimum 12-month manufacturer warranty

title: Dead on Arrival and Transit Damage Reporting
what_to_do: Initiate a free replacement for dead-on-arrival or transit-damaged items reported within 48 hours of delivery with unboxing photos.
never: Never process transit damage claims under DOA replacement after the 48-hour reporting window has expired.
limit: Must be reported within 48 hours of delivery

title: Free Replacement Dispatch and Out-of-Stock Policy
what_to_do: Confirm dispatch of the validated replacement within 24 to 48 hours, or offer an alternative model or full refund in 5 to 7 business days if out of stock.
limit: Replacement dispatched in 24 to 48 hours; out-of-stock refund in 5 to 7 business days

title: Brand Authorized Service Center Routing
what_to_do: Direct the customer to the brand's authorized service center with their toll-free number, local address, and invoice link for issues past the 7-day return window.
never: Never accept standard product returns for functional defects reported after the 7-day return window has expired.
limit: Applies after the 7-day electronics return window

title: ShopEase Assured Doorstep Warranty Service
what_to_do: Arrange complimentary doorstep pickup and transit for ShopEase Assured items if no brand service center exists within 30 km, with a 14-day turnaround.
limit: No service center within 30 km; maximum 14 business days resolution or full refund

title: Extended Warranty and Accidental Protection
what_to_do: Explain that extended warranty activates after the initial 12 months, and accidental protection covers one repair per rolling year with a Rs 250 deductible.
limit: Activates after initial 12 months; 1 claim per 12-month policy year; Rs 250 deductible

title: Refurbished and Open-Box Warranty Rules
what_to_do: Inform the customer that certified refurbished and open-box electronic devices carry a 6-month ShopEase warranty and standard 7-day return eligibility.
never: Never promise standard 12-month warranty terms on certified refurbished or open-box merchandise.
limit: 6-month warranty; 7-day return window; 48-hour damage reporting window
